layers.nm: Nerve injuries are the most severe when all layers of the nerve are damaged.  Axons in the entire nerve are affected, making it hard to pass signals between the brain and body.

s.t: Nerve injuries are the most severe when all layers of the nerve are damaged.Axons in the entire nerve are affected, making it hard to pass signals between the brain and body.

layers.nm: The long extensions from these neurons are called axons. Axons are responsible for carrying the signal from neurons to your muscles.  Each neuron is wrapped in a layer of connective tissue called the endoneurium.

s.t: The long extensions from these neurons are called axons. Axons are responsible for carrying the signal from neurons to your muscles.Each neuron is wrapped in a layer of connective tissue called the endoneurium.

layers.nm: Each fascicle is wrapped in their own protective layer of connective tissue called the perineurium.  A fascicle is made up of bundles of specialized nerve cells called neurons.

s.t: Each fascicle is wrapped in their own protective layer of connective tissue called the perineurium.A fascicle is made up of bundles of specialized nerve cells called neurons.

layers.nm: Each nerve is surrounded by a layer  of connective tissue called the epineurium.  Within the nerve, you will find fat, blood vessels, and smaller nerve bundles called fascicles.

layers.nm: There are several layers of organization within a nerve.   These layers of connective tissue are important because they help doctors classify the severity of nerve injury.
